metaDescription: Browse custom midweight apparel accessories for bulk orders. Perfect for layering and year-round use. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Midweight apparel accessories offer the ideal balance between lightweight options and heavy-duty gear, making them suitable for layering in cooler weather or standalone use in mild climates. For corporate events, uniforms, or promotional giveaways, midweight accessories like beanies, scarves, and gloves provide comfort and durability without excessive bulk. They accept embroidery, screen printing, and heat transfer decorations, ensuring your logo stands out while recipients stay comfortable.
